name: Billy Doe Meats
verdict: For Billy Doe Meats, the biggest movement is a 59.26% drop in Google Business Profile actions over the last 7 days, likely driven by reduced local search visibility or seasonal dip in foot traffic intent, though GBP still delivered 423 total actions over 28 days including 43 calls and 78 direction requests. Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend and zero leads in the period, so no paid activity is contributing to traffic.

performance.verdict: Paid ads fully dark since Aug 1; organic holding but fading fast.

findings.text: Zero paid spend across all 28 days — Meta and Google both at $0. No purchases, no ROAS. Revenue engine is completely off.
SOW overdue: Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 was due 2026-08-14 — 15 days elapsed, no completed event recorded.
GBP actions collapsed to 0 on Aug 26–28 (3-day signal), down from a 25–39 range Aug 20–22 — a confirmed 3-day drop, not noise.
GA4 sessions held: last 3 days avg 261 vs prior 3-day avg 308 — modest dip but 7d up 13.26%. Organic search still pulling traffic with zero paid support.
28-day GA4 shows 3,250 conversions on 7,323 sessions (44% rate) with $0 spend — likely a misconfigured conversion event, not real purchases.

suggestions.text: Relaunch Meta campaigns immediately — $0 spend for 28 days violates the $1,000–1,500/mo SOW ad budget commitment.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend has been $0 for every day since Aug 1 — 28 consecutive zero-spend days with zero purchases and zero ROAS. Relaunch Meta campaigns at the SOW-committed floor of ~$33/day ($1,000/mo). Success check: confirmed spend delivery and at least 1 attributed purchase within 72 hours of relaunch. Sohib to confirm with client whether spend was deliberately paused or is a billing/account issue before activating.

suggestions.text: Escalate Live-Cooking Shoot 1 — 15 days overdue; blocks new real-footage creative pipeline needed for relaunch.
suggestions.monday_update: The Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 milestone was due Aug 14 and is 15 days past due with no completed event recorded. This directly bottlenecks the real-footage creative supply required for Meta relaunch (AI video is banned per SOW). Nacer to confirm shoot status with Haney by 2026-09-01. Success check: shoot date confirmed or rescheduled on the Video board by that date.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions — 3 consecutive zero-action days Aug 26–28; re-check 2026-09-01 to distinguish data gap from real drop.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions ran 25–39/day Aug 20–22 then fell to 0 for three straight days (Aug 26–28), a -59.26% 7-day delta. This may be a data reporting lag or a real visibility drop. No paid local campaigns are active to compensate. Re-check GBP dashboard directly on 2026-09-01; if actions remain at 0, escalate to GMB account audit. Success check: actions return above 10/day or a data-gap cause is confirmed.
